paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak of Kefar Itush recited to R. Abba bar Mammal; and Ze'eira (see his entry). R. Yitzḥak Atisha said before R. Ze'eira, in the name of R. Yannai's house, Jerusalem Talmud, Pe'ah, chapter 8, halakhah 5; and chapter BaKol Me'arvin. Ze'eira recited to him, Jerusalem Talmud, Sotah, beginning of chapter 3. R. Ḥiyya, his son. R. Yirmeyah ruled for him, Jerusalem Talmud, Nazir, beginning of chapter 3, and Jerusalem Talmud, Mo'ed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 5. R. Yoḥanan's student (I did not find this).
